title: 特殊值：±0、Infinity 与 NaN 的位模式与语义
expected_output:
=== IEEE 754 special values (double) ===
  +0.0 bits:    0x0000000000000000
  -0.0 bits:    0x8000000000000000
  infinity bits:    0x7FF0000000000000

  0.0 == -0.0            -> true   (they compare equal)
  signbit(-0.0)          -> true   (yet the sign is still recorded)
  1.0 / 0.0              -> inf
  -1.0 / 0.0             -> -inf
  0.0 / 0.0              -> nan

=== NaN never equals anything ===
  nan == nan             -> false
  nan != nan             -> true   (the classic NaN test)
  nan != 1.0             -> true
  isnan(nan)             -> true
  isnan(inf)             -> false

=== propagation ===
  inf + 1.0              -> inf
  inf - inf              -> nan   (invalid operation)
  0.0 * inf              -> nan   (invalid operation)
  inf / inf              -> nan
  1.0 / inf              -> 0x0p+0

rule: comparisons with NaN are all false EXCEPT '!=' which is true
so test with isnan(x) or (x != x); never write  x == NAN
